name: Lemon Oregano Chicken, Feta Mashed Potatoes & Cucumber-Tomato Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into half-moons. Halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and chop potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Add to the pot and cook until very tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan.
Drizzle chicken with oil and season with spices on both sides; arrange in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil the chicken for 5 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice lemon.

Remove baking sheet from the oven. Using tongs, flip the chicken and place a lemon slice on top of each thigh. Return to the oven and continue to broil until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
When the potatoes are tender, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add feta, milk, oil, and spices; blend or mash until smooth.
To serve, divide chicken, salad, and mashed potatoes between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
